summary: Rogers Communications Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its voting results from the Annual General Meeting held April 22, 2026. All director nominees were elected and KPMG LLP was appointed as auditor, each with over 99.9% of votes cast in favor. The filing is a routine disclosure of meeting outcomes required under Canadian securities rules and reported via the foreign-private-issuer form. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, or any other extraordinary corporate action. This is a routine current report.
